answer: Sybil resistance comes from linking bonded collateral to identities and evidence of coordinated equivocation: when k identities equivocate together, penalties scale as O(k²), not as k independent fines. Detection can trigger an additional exponential multiplier in capital loss, rapidly making a large swarm more costly than its apparent voting power warrants. The velvet rule is an anchor, not a bridge to immunity: splitting stake across identities does not dilute correlated-fault exposure.
